sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: emergency vehicles, police stops, work zones, railroad crossings, streetcars and light rail
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Work zone fines are stated only as doubled; no base or doubled amount is printed, so none is taught [A02].
The flagger and automated flagger pictures are not in the extracted text; the light and arm meanings come from the written paragraph [A02].
The ENS sign is described without a phone number in the extracted text, so learners are told only to use the sign on the post near the tracks [A05].
The sample test question pages (physical pages sixty-nine, seventy and seventy-five) are official question text and are not reproduced or paraphrased into facts; one of their answer options about passing a stopped streetcar is not used, and the stay-behind rule follows the streetcar page text [A06].
The distracted driving poster on physical page seventy is campaign art, not rule text, and is not used.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
